title: 第17章 震惊的女教皇娇羞圣女第18章 魂兽绿洲再度震惊破限天才
slug: 双生神级武魂震惊妖帝老婆
content_zh:
;;
“怎么了老师，小师哥有什么问题嘛？”
白莹玥是懂女教皇的，很少有什么事能让对方流露出惊咦的情绪。
帝薇央看着洛凡尘，诧异问道：“你突破了？”
洛凡尘点头承认：“老师慧眼如炬。”
白莹玥轻笑道：“不错嘛小师哥，这才一夜的功夫就突破了。”
“还行。”洛凡尘谦逊一笑。
女教皇冰冷威严的上位者气息让人多少有些拘束，但白莹玥的活泼性格，倒是让洛凡尘轻松自然了许多。
白莹玥有些奇怪的看向女教皇，不解道：
“老师，小师弟突破也不算什么大事，不至于让您如此意外吧。”
女教皇美眸斜了她一眼，红唇轻启，嗓音犹如凤鸣：“确实不算什么大事，只是一夜连升九级罢了。”
“哦，连升九级啊。”
白莹玥下意识点头，接着猛然抬头，卡姿兰的大眼睛瞪的老大，写满了错愕。
“不可能吧！”
“连升九级？？”
“您不会是说小师哥一夜之间从魂士一级，修炼到了魂士十级？”
帝薇央扭头，道：“凡尘，你释放魂力气息。”
“唰！”
洛凡尘将内敛的魂力气息释放。
气势不强，却让白莹玥樱桃小嘴儿张大，仿佛能塞下一根香蕉。

“怎么涨的这么快？”
“太夸张了，小师哥，你不会是嗑药了吧。”
“没有。”
未等洛凡尘说话，帝薇央肯定回答。
“他身上没有灵药残留的气息。”
“哇！那小师哥比我当年厉害多了诶。”白莹玥没有妒忌，手指搭在唇上，回忆道：“我当年觉醒后，一夜也只是连破五境罢了。”
“那四供奉和圣子要是知道小师哥竟然有如此天赋，估计要后悔死。”
洛凡尘摇头，暗道他们估计不会后悔没收我为徒，只会后悔没一拳淦死我。
白莹玥挥了挥秀拳：“小师哥加油，争取有朝一日陪着师姐暴打圣子和供奉狗头。”
洛凡尘嘴角抽搐，他才发现神殿圣女竟然是个话痨，不过一点也不讨人厌，是个漂亮可爱的话痨。
他忍不住问道：“冒昧问一下，你一个神殿圣女，总说要暴打供奉和圣子狗头，这像话么。”
白莹玥轻哼。
“这俩狗东西，一个算计老师，一个想娶我，没一个好东西，都以为我是傻白甜，其实本姑娘这双眼睛雪亮着呢。”
“看来神殿也不是铁板一块儿。”洛凡尘若有所思道。
“当然啦，有权势利益的地方，就有斗争，烦死啦。”白莹玥撇着红唇，美眸上翻，透着一股俏皮活泼的青春气息。
“不过小师哥你没人指导就敢自己瞎修炼，真的超勇哦。”
洛凡尘挠着头，腼腆笑道：
“我就是把外界的灵气一吸，在丹田内一收，最后一看，诶？吸进来的灵气好像全都化成气旋了。”

"What's wrong, teacher? What's the problem, little senior brother?"
Bai Yingyue understood the female pope well, and few things could make her express surprise.
Di Weiyang looked at Luo Fanchen and asked in surprise: "Did you break through?"
Luo Fanchen nodded and admitted: "Teacher has a sharp eye."
Bai Yingyue chuckled and said, "Not bad, little senior brother, I made a breakthrough in just one night's effort."
"It's okay." Luo Fanchen smiled modestly.
The female pope's cold and majestic aura of superiority made people somewhat restrained, but Bai Yingyue's lively personality made Luo Fanchen feel more relaxed and natural.
Bai Yingyue looked at the female pope strangely and said in confusion:
"Teacher, my junior brother's breakthrough is not a big deal. It won't surprise you so much."
The female pope glanced sideways at her with her beautiful eyes, her red lips parted slightly, and her voice sounded like a phoenix: "It's really not a big deal, it's just a nine-level upgrade overnight."
"Oh, I've been upgraded to nine levels in a row."
Bai Yingyue nodded subconsciously, then raised her head suddenly. Kazilan's big eyes were wide open, filled with astonishment.
"No way!"
"Upgraded to nine levels in a row??"
"Aren't you saying that my junior brother has cultivated from the first level soul warrior to the tenth level soul warrior overnight?"
Di Weiyang turned her head and said, "Fanchen, release your soul power."
"Uh-huh!"
Luo Fanchen released his restrained soul power.
The momentum was not strong, but it made Bai Yingyue's little cherry mouth open as wide as if she could stuff a banana.
"Why did it rise so fast?"
"That's too exaggerated. Junior Brother, you couldn't be taking drugs."
"No."
Before Luo Fanchen could speak, Di Weiyang answered affirmatively.
"There is no residual aura of the elixir on him."
"Wow! That junior brother is much better than me back then." Bai Yingyue was not jealous, she put her finger on her lips and recalled: "After I awakened back then, I only broke through five realms in one night."
"If the four priests and the Holy Son knew that my junior brother had such a talent, they would probably regret it to death."
Luo Fanchen shook his head and thought to himself that they probably would not regret taking me as their disciple, but they would only regret not punching me to death.
Bai Yingyue waved her show fist: "Come on, little senior brother, and try to accompany my senior sister to beat up the Holy Son and worship the dog's head one day."
The corner of Luo Fanchen's mouth twitched, and he realized that the temple saint turned out to be a talkative girl, but she was not annoying at all, she was a beautiful and lovely talkative girl.
He couldn't help but ask: "I would like to ask, you, a saint in the temple, always say that you want to beat the heads of the worshipers and the Holy Son. Is this ridiculous?"
Bai Yingyue hummed.
"These two idiots, one is a calculating teacher and the other wants to marry me. Neither of them is a good guy. They both think I am stupid and sweet. In fact, my eyes are very bright."
"It seems that the temple is not monolithic." Luo Fanchen said thoughtfully.
"Of course, where there is power and interest, there will be struggle, and it's so annoying." Bai Yingyue curled her red lips and turned her beautiful eyes upward, exuding a playful and lively youthful atmosphere.
"But Junior Brother, you dare to practice blindly on your own without any guidance. You are really brave."
Luo Fanchen scratched his head and smiled shyly:
"I just sucked in the spiritual energy from the outside world and collected it in my Dantian. At the last look, eh? All the spiritual energy I breathed in seemed to have turned into a cyclone."
